name: @sunnyside-io/privacy-boost
description: TypeScript SDK for PrivacyBoost - WASM-powered privacy operations

scripts.build: tsc && rm -rf dist/wasm dist/wasm-nodejs && cp -r src/wasm dist/wasm && cp -r src/wasm-nodejs dist/wasm-nodejs && node scripts/fix-esm-extensions.mjs dist
scripts.prepack: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const has=d=>fs.existsSync(d)&&fs.readdirSync(d).some(f=>f.endsWith('.wasm'));const missing=[];if(!fs.existsSync('src/core/wasm-binary.ts'))missing.push('src/core/wasm-binary.ts (run make wasm)');if(!has('src/wasm-nodejs'))missing.push('src/wasm-nodejs/*.wasm (run make wasm-nodejs)');if(missing.length){console.error('ERROR: missing WASM build artifacts: '+missing.join(', '));process.exit(1)}"
